candidate_delta: None. The qualification ran in a separate worktree checked out at the tag commit and recorded that commit and an empty working-tree patch (the digest above is that of an empty patch).

sandbox_image.distribution: Built locally with scripts/build-sandbox.sh on 2026-11-24 from the 0.2.4 Dockerfile the tag carries. The image published to GitHub Container Registry for this release is a separate build of the same Dockerfile; its Ubuntu packages are not version-pinned and can differ (each image lists them in /usr/share/doc/oxfuzz-sandbox/packages.tsv).

review: Provider review passed before execution for all three engines, using a local Ollama model (qwen3:8b), as for 0.9.10. Explicit human approval was supplied for this exact source pair on 2026-11-25; the pair is unchanged since 0.9.10.
limitations: One short cycle per engine does not establish long-duration stability or a statistical latency percentile.
No crashes occurred; crash reproduction and symbolization are not claimed by this cycle.
Executed on macOS arm64 with a Linux arm64 Docker sandbox; not a Linux desktop installation test. Windows is not supported.
The pre-execution review used a small local model rather than the provider configured for the desktop app.

This cycle covers C sources on libFuzzer, AFL++ and honggfuzz. The Go, Python, Java, JavaScript and binary-only engines were not rerun for 0.9.11; their last live results are the 0.9.8 related record, made on a different commit.
The qualification drives the service operations from a test, not from the desktop app.
